messages:
Alex (Growth): Heads up — planning post-incident comms for yesterday's eu-west inference degradation. Need quick alignment on status page wording, customer email timing, and whether we fold a note into next week's benchmarks webinar. Who's available?

Maria (PMM): Recommend a two-step comms cadence: immediate status page + targeted emails to affected customers, then an RCA + blog post within 48h. Keep the initial message factual and short.

Sophie (Prod Marketing): Agreed. Draft initial status copy below — neutral tone, impact, mitigation, next steps. Avoid speculative language.

Sophie (Prod Marketing): ```
We experienced elevated inference errors in the eu-west cluster between 10:12–10:47 UTC.
Impact: Some customers saw increased errors and degraded latency for hosted and dedicated inference.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to failover region; a hotfix was deployed at 10:45 UTC.
Next update: We will publish a detailed root-cause analysis within 48 hours.
```

Jamal (Support): We have the full list of affected accounts. Proposal: AE outreach to top 5 Dedicated customers within 2 hours, templated email to broader impacted Hosted customers. Also add CRM tag `eu-west-incident-177010` so SalesOps can filter.

Chris (EngOps): Add a short FAQ note on the status page clarifying that no customer data was exposed and that KV caches were rebuilt as part of the fix. I'll confirm the exact language in 10m.

Alex (Growth): Timing suggestion: publish initial status now, target email in ~45 mins once we attach affected-account list, and publish RCA + blog + webinar segment after RCA (target within 48h). OK?

Sophie (Prod Marketing): For the webinar: don't cancel. Instead add a 15-min 'lessons learned' segment up front and mention the incident in the intro so attendees see we're transparent. We can also use a short slide to explain mitigations and what customers can expect.

Maria (PMM): Routing for inbound leads: update the contact form so any message containing 'degraded', 'errors', or 'inference' and region 'eu-west' gets `incident_followup` metadata. Automation: create a SalesOps task tagged `incident-outreach` for Dedicated customers only. Hosted tickets go to Support with a priority flag.

Jamal (Support): I'll export list and flag accounts in CRM with the `eu-west-incident-177010` tag. Will pass AE list to SalesOps in 20m.

Alex (Growth): Who publishes the status page and who sends the customer email? Propose: @Sophie publishes status now, @Jamal hands the AE list to SalesOps, I send the customer email once list is confirmed.

Sophie (Prod Marketing): Publishing initial status now. Header one-liner I used: `Service disruption in eu-west — partial impact; mitigation in place.` Putting the full text up and pinning. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Deploy bot: Build 8721 rolled to eu-west at 10:45 UTC — tag: hotfix/kv-fix

Chris (EngOps): Confirmed language on FAQ: `No customer data was exposed. The issue affected in-memory KV caches and was mitigated by failover and cache rebuilds.` OK to include.

Maria (PMM): Small note on benchmarks: any published latency/cost numbers that included the incident window should get an asterisk and an updated timestamp. We should call this out in the benchmark narrative so we don't accidentally skew results.

Alex (Growth): Good catch. We'll add a callout on the benchmarks page and in the webinar slides: `Results exclude the eu-west incident window; updated replay scheduled.`

Sophie (Prod Marketing): Quick checklist for next 2 hours: publish status (done), AE list -> SalesOps (Jamal), customer email draft (Alex), FAQ + RCA ETA (Chris + Eng). I'll draft the webinar intro slide and circulate.

Jamal (Support): Exported list queued, will send to SalesOps in 12m.

Alex (Growth): OK — if there are no objections we'll send the targeted email at +45. Check-in here in 40. Thanks all. :eyes:
